title: UN SecGen, Barbados PM hold press conference at Bridgetown Special Summit on AI Safety
summary: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres and Barbados Prime Minister Mia Amor Mottley speak at the Bridgetown Special Summit on AI Safety

blocks.text: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres and Barbados Prime Minister Mia Amor Mottley speak at the Bridgetown Special Summit on AI Safety
UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres and Barbados Prime Minister Mia Amor Mottley speak at the Bridgetown Special Summit on AI Safety held on November 23.

Senior representatives from governments, tech companies, the scientific community, and civil society met in Barbados to discuss international cooperation on artificial intelligence safety, and how to share the benefits of AI development more widely.
